title: fix(rest): the dataset door judges a holder whose own address a row no one module owns contends, so the name refuses 409, not 503 (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDwkEEJd65kqFZGFjQnzBQt)_

Fixes #32948
Fixes #32826

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`POST /analytics/dataset/query`（含批量接口每一条）在"一行无主的存储行挡在 App 两个模块各自地址上"时，不再对所有调用者答 503；改为按该模块自己的数据集判准入：能查的模块在 409 里点名，不能查的不点名，一个都不能查答 404，被挡住的模块永不执行。另外：仍然答 503 的情形，服务端日志写明是哪些持有包判不了、为什么；拒绝识别函数合并成一份；文档补齐。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D4 说这种行不属于任何一个持有包，名字应当以 409 点名持有包拒绝；原来的准入规则把每个模块地址上的拒绝当成"判不了"，于是对所有人 503。
- 风险与回滚：只动"按名读被拒"的准入分支里"持有包自己地址被争用"这一种拒绝形状；其他形状仍判不了、仍 503。有一格是放宽（另一个包的持有项是调用者唯一能查的，503 → 200 并执行它，与 #32292 的一格规则一致），已声明 `yes (widening)`；该放宽只在裸名读取上发生，在某个模块自己的 `?package=` / `?callerPackage=` 上，另一个包的持有项不在被拒候选里，不会被跨过去执行（答 404，或 409 只点名该模块）。只剩一个可查持有包的 409 文案不提、不计数任何被隐藏的持有包。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-admission-order.ts`（`isOwnAddressContention` 与 `judge` 两处，风险在"被争用的持有包永不执行"）；`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts` 里的 `listHolder`（只取该持有包自己的那一项）；`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts` 的 `[#32948]` 钉子。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/analytics-routes.test.ts -t '32948|32826'`，预期 10 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Premise check first.** The card's literal composition does not answer `503` on `main` (`ba35dfd78`) or on PR #32808's landing head (`c50d10c00`): a package-less dataset row beside the App's two modules is declined at each module's own address for a dataset (epic ruling 6817768147, the `[#32568]` pin already in this file), so `?package=APP.custom` is judged over the modules as if the row were not there (both admitted `409` naming both, one admitted runs it, none `404`). Measured over seven stagings (the row in the registry's bare slot with `_provenance: 'org'`, stamped `sys_metadata` or `''`, before or after the modules; a stored `sys_metadata` row with `package_id` null; a `metadata` service copy stamped `''`, `sys_metadata` or unstamped), with and without the pair installed, both orders: each module's own exact read serves its own dataset. That composition is now a CONTROL pin.

**The 503 the card describes is real in a sibling form**, the one the #32804 review (N5) said "can be staged with the registry's own `registerItem`": an App pair's row that names no module, hydrated into the registry's bare slot (the registry binds it to no package; stamp `APP.custom`). Either module could own it, so it is no one holder's customization (ADR-0150 D4; epic ruling on #31699 F2), and each module's own exact read refuses `ambiguous-in-closure`, read as that module and naming both. The admission arm read every per-holder refusal as "cannot be judged", so on `main` the bare read, a module's `?package=` and a module's `?callerPackage=` all answered `503` for every caller, in both orders, single door and batch alike.

Now `admitRefusedDatasetHolders` recognises that one shape (`isOwnAddressContention`: `ambiguous-in-closure`, `callerPackageId` the holder itself, only package candidates, the holder among them) and judges such a holder on its own dataset as the list scoped to it serves it (`getMetaItems({ type: 'dataset', packageId, names: [name] })`, which withholds the row; only an item stamped with that holder counts). That is how `query_dataset` judges every holder. A contended holder is never picked or run; admitted, it is named in the `409`; not admitted, it is not named. Every other refusal of a holder's own read stays undetermined, as before.

Moved answers (refusal arm only, plugin-wired admission):

| Case (holders' own addresses contended) | FROM | TO |
|---|---|---|
| admitted to two or more holders | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming those holders |
| admitted to exactly one contended holder | `503` | `409` naming that holder only, nothing run |
| admitted to none | `503` | `404 NOT_FOUND`, byte-equal to a missing name's |
| admitted only to another package's holder whose address is not contended (bare read) | `503` | `200`, that holder runs (the one-admitted rule of #32292, now reached): the widening arm |
| the same caller at `?package=` or `?callerPackage=` a contended module | `503` | `404 NOT_FOUND`, byte-equal to a missing name's; that holder is not a refused candidate there, so it is never reached across to |
| admitted to that holder and to one module, at that module's `?package=` or `?callerPackage=` | `503` | `409` naming that module only |

An ambiguity narrowed to one contended holder gets its own sentence instead of the vocabulary's "is held by 1 packages … address it by its package", which would be wrong twice (a count of one, and a remedy that answers the same refusal). The sentence speaks of that one package and the row only: `The dataset "NAME" cannot be read at package "ID": a stored row of the name stands beside that package's item and is not saved under it, so nothing is run until the row is saved under a package (ADR-0150 D4).` It names, counts or implies no other holder: a holder the caller may not query stays hidden, and the refusal body carries only `code` and `message` (no candidates, reason or details). Seat amendment (2) on this PR replaced an earlier wording that said the row was one "no one package owns".

#32826 (loose ends of PR #32804), folded in:

1. **Real-arrangement pins.** The contention form is pinned over the real `SchemaRegistry` and `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` (the `[#32948]` pins). The package-less form is declined, already pinned by `[#32568]`. The first-read form that never reaches the per-holder catch (the App pair address itself refusing, two modules holding the name) is pinned by the `#32501` describe's `judgedOverAdmission`, which landed with #32808. No staging measured here still reaches the per-holder undetermined path through a real refusal; the protocol double that pins it now says which shape it stands for.
2. **The `503`'s cause.** The undetermined answer carries a cause naming each holder that could not be judged and why (its own read refused, with the reason; its address served nothing; its admission was unresolved; contended but not listed). The door's `logError` prints it. The body is unchanged and names no holder.
3. **One recogniser.** `isPackageScopedRefusal` is exported from `analytics-dataset-admission-order.ts` and used by the door and the rule; the copy in `analytics-routes.ts` is gone.
4. **Partial-judgement wording.** Docs only: `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` says a `409` reached with some holders unjudged names only the judged ones. The changeset half points at a released `CHANGELOG.md` entry and is split out (Acceptance notes).
5. **Docs clause.** The page says what the door answers after this fix: a package-less row moves no answer for a dataset; an App pair row that names no module contends each module's address, and such a module is judged on its own dataset.
6. **Census wording.** `ambiguous-in-namespace` stays in the rule's ambiguity set, with the reason in the comment: only a namespace address is refused with it, the dataset doors never name a namespace, and listing it keeps an ambiguity from ever being judged as `outside-closure`.

## Tests

`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts`, ten new cases:

- `[#32948]` in the `#32501` describe (real registry and protocol; analytics double admitting by object; `both()` drives the single door and a one-entry batch): the contention pin, both orders, on the bare read, `?package=` a module and `?callerPackage=` a module, every admission cell; the widening pin with a third package registered first and last (bare read); the module-address pin, both orders, at `?package=` a module and `?callerPackage=` a module with that third package present: admitted to it alone answers the missing name's `404` byte for byte, admitted to it and one module answers `409` naming that module only; every one-module `409` cell (contention pin and module-address pin) also asserts the hidden holder is neither named nor implied: body keys exactly `code` and `message` (batch entry `status` and `error`), no hidden id in the text, no holder count, and none of `packages`, `holders`, `other`, `another`, `both`, `each`, `either`, `no one`, `ambiguous`, `pick` in the sentence; CONTROL: a package-less row beside the two modules, `?package=APP.custom` judged as with no row; CONTROL: one module, the pair row is its customization, served, admission not asked.
- `[#32826]` in the `#32292` describe: the undetermined `503` logs an error whose cause names both unjudged holders and the refusal reason; the body names neither.

Red on `main`, green here, one ablation per pin. Each ablation leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob moved, restored blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests import the rule and the door from source, so no rebuild between legs. Leg M put `origin/main`'s blobs of both source files (`05e9c422`, `662e822c`) under this head's tests and restored them with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, blob-checked.

| Pin | HEAD | M (main) | A1 `ABLATE_32948_NOJUDGE` (contention not judged) | A2 `ABLATE_32948_RUNNABLE` (a contended holder runnable) | A3 `ABLATE_32826_NOCAUSE` (no cause) | A4 (the earlier one-holder sentence restored) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| contention: 409 naming the admitted modules, none run, none → 404, hidden holder not implied (one first / two first) | green | **red** (503) | **red** | **red** | green | **red** (the sentence matches the implication pattern) |
| widening: another package's sole admitted holder runs; with a module, 409 names both (alpha first / last) | green | **red** (503) | **red** | green | green | green |
| module address: the uncontended holder not reached across to; 404 alone, 409 naming the module only, hidden holder not implied (alpha first / last) | green | **red** (503) | not run | **red** (the module runs) | not run | **red** |
| the undetermined 503 logs its cause | green | **red** | green | green | **red** | green |
| CONTROL: package-less row beside the modules (two orders) | green | green | green | green | green | green |
| CONTROL: one module, pair row served | green | green | green | green | green | green |

Leg M, A2 and A4 were rerun at `cfc3b3dd3` over the ten cases: M 7 failed / 3 passed (every module-address cell `503`); A2 4 failed / 6 passed; A4 4 failed / 6 passed; each restored blob-equal to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. A1 and A3 rows are from head `7eae0dea1` and were not rerun for the new pin.

## Acceptance notes

- **Seat amendment (1), measured otherwise than asked:** the amendment asked for the widening (sole admitted holder uncontended, `200`) at `?package=MODULE` and `?callerPackage=MODULE` too. There the read refuses the module's name over the two modules only; the third package's holder is not a refused candidate, so the one-admitted rule never sees it. Running it would serve another package's dataset at a module's exact address, a pick that address does not make. The pin asserts what the door answers: `404` (byte-equal to a missing name's) for the caller admitted to that holder alone, `409` naming only the module for the caller admitted beside it. Moving that to `200` would be a further widening and a seat call; it is not in this PR.
- **Split out (#32826 item 4, changeset half):** the consumed changeset of PR #32804 now lives in the released `packages/rest/CHANGELOG.md` entry. Its pointer "so the row above applies to it" points at the `503` row, and it has no row for a `409` reached with some holders unjudged. That amendment is a docs-only PR to the released entry, owned by the area session.
- **Door-local sentence:** the one-holder narrowed ambiguity is worded in the rule, not in `@objectstack/core`'s vocabulary. The structured `reason` and `candidates` are the vocabulary's.
- **Noted, not filed:** the protocol's own refusal at a contended module address (`GET /meta/dataset/NAME?package=MODULE`) also says "address it by its package", which answers the same refusal there. The text is in `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`; this PR does not touch it.
- **Not measured:** a real kernel boot reaching the App-pair-row-in-the-bare-slot state through its own load path (the #32804 review said the same of its staging). The registry staging is the one N5 named.

## Verification

Those 95 were read at `7eae0dea1`; for the amendment the 27 docs, changeset and prose families among them were rerun over `b89bfcd08`'s tree, all exit 0, and `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` OK. No dogfood battery: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
